title: Hearing on building the early childhood educator workforce
summary: The Council will hold a joint oversight hearing on the pipeline for early childhood educators in New York City, examining credentialing requirements, CUNY degree and certificate programs, and workforce development initiatives like apprenticeships and scholarships. The hearing will also consider a companion bill to create a child care workforce grant and services program. Witnesses will include officials from the Mayor's Office of Child Care and Early Childhood Education, the Department of Education, NYC Talent and CUNY, along with educators and advocates.
